nodes.description: Public address state variable 'dead' initialized to address(0); never read or written after declaration in this contract.
Public address state variable 'owner'; set in constructor from msg.sender and updated by transferOwnership. Used as the authorization anchor in the onlyOwner modifier.
Public IERC20 state variable 'dpr'; the token contract whose safeTransfer is invoked by to_dead and withdraw.
Constructor(address _dpr): assigns dpr = IERC20(_dpr) and owner = msg.sender, establishing initial ownership and token target.
Modifier onlyOwner: requires(msg.sender == owner, "Not Owner"). Access-control gate applied to to_dead, withdraw and transferOwnership.
External onlyOwner function to_dead(uint256 _amount): executes dpr.safeTransfer(owner, _amount), moving tokens out of the contract to the owner.
External onlyOwner function withdraw(uint256 _amount): executes dpr.safeTransfer(owner, _amount) with externally supplied amount.
External onlyOwner function transferOwnership(address _newOwner): overwrites owner with _newOwner, transferring full control of the contract.
Caller-supplied address, used as constructor owner assignment and as the subject of the onlyOwner authorization check.
Constructor parameter _dpr: the ERC20 token address supplied at deployment, cast to IERC20 and stored in state variable dpr.
Parameter _amount of to_dead: token amount forwarded to dpr.safeTransfer for the owner.
Parameter _amount of withdraw: token amount forwarded to dpr.safeTransfer for the owner.
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership: address written directly into the owner state variable.
External ERC20 interaction dpr.safeTransfer(owner, _amount) inside to_dead; performs a low-level call to the token contract before/after state effects.
External ERC20 interaction dpr.safeTransfer(owner, _amount) inside withdraw; performs a low-level call to the token contract with a caller-controlled amount.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read in the constructor and written into the owner state variable, making initial ownership caller-controlled.
The onlyOwner modifier compares the untrusted msg.sender against owner to gate privileged functions.
to_dead is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier, so execution is conditional on the msg.sender == owner check.
withdraw is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier, so execution is conditional on the msg.sender == owner check.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier, so only the current owner can reassign control.
The constructor parameter _dpr is cast to IERC20 and stored into the dpr state variable, determining the token targeted by later transfers.
The dpr state variable supplies the target contract for the safeTransfer call inside to_dead.
The dpr state variable supplies the target contract for the safeTransfer call inside withdraw.
The _amount parameter flows directly into the safeTransfer value argument of to_dead.
The _amount parameter flows directly into the safeTransfer value argument of withdraw.
The _newOwner parameter is written into the owner state variable, transferring privileged control without a two-step handover.
The safeTransfer in to_dead performs an external low-level call to the token contract, allowing re-entry into to_dead/withdraw before the transfer completes.
The safeTransfer in withdraw performs an external low-level call to the token contract, allowing re-entry into withdraw/to_dead with a caller-controlled amount.

normalization_plan.reason: The _dpr parameter only exists to initialize the dpr state variable inside the constructor and has no independent semantic identity.
The _amount parameter is a transient value consumed only by the safeTransfer call inside to_dead and should be absorbed into that unsafe operation.
The _amount parameter is a transient value consumed only by the safeTransfer call inside withdraw and should be absorbed into that unsafe operation.
The _newOwner parameter is immediately assigned to the owner state variable and has no behavior beyond the ownership-transfer function it belongs to.
